title: A component with its own lexicon
lead: The block below owns an instance of its own. Its keys live beside the component, so it can be dropped into another application without touching that application's translations.

own.title: Its own instance
own.text: new I18n(config) inside the component. Two instances coexist — the page's and the component's.

csr.title: Loaded in the browser
csr.text: A component has no load of its own, so its loaders run after hydration. Watch the placeholder on a slow connection.

destroy.title: Destroyed with the component
destroy.text: The instance is torn down when the component unmounts, so nothing is left behind.
